entities.summary: Sultan Ahmed ibn Sulayem (b. 1955, Emirate of Dubai) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Emirate of Dubai and United Arab Emirates. Known in the fields of united arab emirates, merchants & economists, asia.
